faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tahsildar Office Lanja to fill vacant positions in the Ratnagiri district of Maharashtra through an offline application process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Revenue Servant (Kotwal), offering temporary employment opportunities under the Tahsildar Office Lanja administration for eligible local candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) position under this recruitment notification published by Tahsildar Office Lanja.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post must possess a minimum educational qualification of passing the 4th class successfully.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of the last date of application submission, which is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post will receive a fixed consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to obtain, complete, and submit the offline application form to the Tahsildar Office Lanja is 17-10-2026 by 06:15 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: Other categories / general candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- whereas backward class and EWS candidates pay Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written examination consisting of 50 objective questions for 100 marks, followed by document verification for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website of Ratnagiri district at www.ratnagiri.nic.in to access all recruitment notifications, application guidelines, and related updates.
